title: ADV350 Maxi (Touring Pack)
description: Engineered for riders seeking confident performance and refined dynamics, the Honda ADV350 Maxi (Touring Pack) is purpose-built to crush coast-to-coast highway miles and conquer rugged backcountry tracks. At its heart lies a 350cc powertrain delivering 43 HP and 37 Nm of torque, tuned to translate its 163 kg mass into punchy mid-range acceleration. Riders are greeted by an ergonomic Upright Neutral posture paired with a balanced 790mm seat height providing confident footing and natural knee comfort, backed by a 13.5L fuel tank for extended saddle stints.
yoast_title: Honda ADV350 Maxi (Touring Pack): Specs, Price & Recommended Helmets
yoast_metadesc: Complete specs, engine power, weight, and verified helmet compatibility guide for the Honda ADV350 Maxi (Touring Pack).

qualitative_intelligence.rider_ergonomics_review: Balanced, natural roadster ergonomics. Slight forward torso incline puts just enough weight over the front tire for confident front-end grip in canyon twisties, while maintaining a neutral peg-to-seat triangle that keeps your knees relaxed for all-day riding.
qualitative_intelligence.engine_character_soundtrack: Quiet, refined single-cylinder hum engineered for frugality and easy low-end tractability. The clutch lever pull is light as a feather, making city traffic crawling virtually effortless.
qualitative_intelligence.helmet_pairing_insights: Pairs best with a versatile Full Face street helmet featuring Pinlock anti-fog lenses and speaker cutouts for Bluetooth intercoms (such as the Shoei RF-1400 or Scorpion EXO-R1 Air).
real_world_pros: Versatile daily balance between commuting comfort and weekend fun
Predictable, easy-to-modulate throttle response for riders of all skill levels
Upright seating stance gives great road visibility and zero back strain
real_world_cons: Highway wind buffeting at speeds above 115 km/h without a windscreen
Stock seat padding may start to feel firm after 2.5 hours of continuous riding
qualitative_intelligence.editorial_verdict: The Honda ADV350 Maxi (Touring Pack) delivers an authentic, satisfying riding experience in the Roadster / Commuter segment. With its 43 HP motor and well-balanced chassis geometry, Honda has built a motorcycle that rewards riders with genuine feedback, practical daily usability, and solid overall engineering integrity.
qualitative_intelligence.visor_optics_recommendation: Clear anti-fog with internal drop-down Amber Sun Visor
qualitative_intelligence.canyon_cornering_personality: Plush yet controlled turn-in. Long-travel suspension absorbs mid-corner ruts effortlessly, giving you supreme confidence on rough asphalt or broken tarmac.
qualitative_intelligence.highway_crosswind_stability: Heavy 195kg+ chassis mass and wide wheelbase provide solid stability when passing high-speed semi-trucks, though high winds hit the tall windscreen noticeably.
qualitative_intelligence.urban_heat_management: Excellent thermal isolation; minimal heat felt at rider ankles even during prolonged stop-and-go commuting.

rider_fit_suitability_matrix.beginner_suitability_eval: Highly recommended for novice riders due to gentle throttle response, low seat height, and forgiving clutch modulation.
rider_fit_suitability_matrix.pillion_passenger_comfort: 8.8 / 10 (Generous padded grab rails, wide passenger seat cushion, and relaxed footpeg drop)
rider_fit_suitability_matrix.maintenance_ease_index: 8.5 / 10 (Simple single/twin cylinder oil changes every 6,000 km with easy filter access)
rider_fit_suitability_matrix.cold_weather_rain_rating: 9.2 / 10 (High windscreen, handguards, and splash guards keep rider dry in rain)
